title: Rust Structure-Choice Plan
description: A structured plan naming the shape of each relationship in a data-modeling problem and the structural choices made for it, so this skill's thesis (choose the structure that makes ownership trivial; arena+indices over Rc<RefCell>) and its Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/structure_choice_audit.mjs.

shape.description: The shape of this relationship per this skill's Decision Points flowchart.

usesRcRefCellOnNode.description: True if the node type in this relationship is wrapped in Rc<RefCell<...>>.

usesArcMutexOnNode.description: True if the node type in this relationship is wrapped in Arc<Mutex<...>> (the threaded version of the Rc<RefCell> trap).

deletableGraphUsesStableGraph.description: For shape=graph: true if a deletable/mutable graph uses petgraph::StableGraph (rather than plain Graph with stored NodeIndex).

generationalIndex.description: For shape=pool: true if reused slots are tracked with a generational index (slotmap/generational-arena) rather than a bare usize/handle.

smallvecJustifiedByBench.description: True if an inline vector (smallvec/tinyvec/arrayvec) in this relationship is backed by a benchmark and a 'usually < N' claim, not reflex.

concurrentMap.description: The concurrent map/access strategy chosen when this relationship is shared and mutated across threads.

handRolledLockFree.description: Describes any hand-rolled (non-crossbeam) lock-free code used for this relationship.

present.description: True if this relationship includes hand-rolled lock-free code (raw atomics + CAS) rather than crossbeam-epoch/-queue.

hasEpochOrHazard.description: True if the hand-rolled lock-free code uses epoch-based reclamation or hazard pointers instead of freeing immediately.

hasLoom.description: True if the hand-rolled lock-free code has a Loom model test covering its interleavings.

cheapCloneUsesPersistent.description: For shape=shared: true if cheap-clone snapshots use Cow/im/rpds (structural sharing) rather than a deep clone() of the whole collection.

hasherDeliberate.description: True if the hasher for this relationship's map is a deliberate choice: SipHash default kept only if keys are untrusted, otherwise fxhash/ahash with a note.
